name: Quad Cities Flood Projections
description: SCOUT's flooding use case over the Quad Cities: seven GeoTIFFs on one grid (EPSG:4326, about 11 m cells). NBS_others_5m.tif is the nature-based solution (NbS) class of each cell: 21 bioswales/infiltration trenches, 31 permeable pavements, 43 retention ponds, 52 infiltration trench, 71 and 81 bioswales, 90 and 95 constructed wetlands, 0 none. <period>_NbS.tif and <period>_noNbS.tif are the projected flood depth in metres for 2020_2040, 2050_2080 and 2080_2100, with NbS and without; NaN where a projection gives no depth. Read one with curio_load_data("data.scout.quad-cities-flood", part="2020_2040_NbS.tif").
